ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Neptune

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your career and your image. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up home and family.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and your career. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between family and relationships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and routine. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between money and romance. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your image and family. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1829304797000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and money. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.
